title: Mofka as a Building Block for Resilient HPC Workflows
summary: Mofka's persistence and RDMA-optimized transport make it an attractive substrate for workflow resilience layers. Systems such as StreamGuard and RESILIO build directly on Mofka's topic-based publish/subscribe model to provide fault tolerance, recovery, and composable pipeline architectures for streaming HPC applications at supercomputer scale.
